scope: Read-only preparation. No record was modified while producing this manifest. Proposed actions are executed only by scripts/apply_quarantine_manifest.py with --execute, and only for entries carrying reviewed_by + reviewed_at.

baseline.query: SELECT extraction_status, count(*) FROM scholarship GROUP BY 1

verification_method.db: Read-only SQL over scholarship, provider, country, scholarship_timeline and source_registry.
verification_method.live_fetch: HTTP GET of each official_page_url on 2026-10-15 with User-Agent PolarisCatalogueAudit/1.0, recording status, final URL, <title> and keyword signals (studentship, salary, closing date, scholarship, deadline).
verification_method.no_host_whitelist: Hostname was never used as a reason on its own. Every record in categories A and B carries per-record evidence from the page it points at.
